description: Requests whose App Check token was missing or invalid, excluding the exempt probe paths (/, /api, /health). 'missing' is only logged when enforcement rejects the request; 'invalid' is logged for every failed verification and carries exempt=true on probe paths.
filter:
resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
jsonPayload.event="app_check"
jsonPayload.outcome=("missing" OR "invalid")
NOT jsonPayload.exempt=true
